newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate to quiz cenbank nominee Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate to quiz cenbank nominee Thursday.

text.p: Brazilian senators will quiz Gustavo Franco, nominated as the new Central Bank president, Thursday, a Central Bank spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said Franco, currently director of international affairs, would present himself to the Economic Affairs Committee at 1000 local/1300 GMT.
The Senate must approve Franco's nomination as successor to Gustavo Loyola, who announced his resignation last week citing personal reasons.
Franco has had a stormy relationship with Congress.

But political analysts say they expect his name to be approved, even if senators take advantage of the nomination hearings to argue for more flexible spending and interest rate policies in election year 1998.
Franco's successor as international affairs director, as well as a successor for Director of Controls Alkimar Moura, who has also chosen to resign, have yet to be named.
